function.name: introduction_greet
function.description: Generate a greeting message introducing a person and their relationship to another individual. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

name.description: The name of the person being introduced.

relationship.description: The type of relationship to the related person.

related_person.description: The name of the person to whom the first person is related.

include_relationship.description: A flag to indicate whether to include the relationship in the greeting message.
